profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Contracts 365
profile.summary:
With over 10 years of experience in software development, I am a Senior Software Engineer at Contracts 365, a company that provides contract management software for contract professionals. I have a Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate credential, and I am proficient in Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, and Azure Key Vault.

In my current role, I lead a cross-functional team of five developers and engineers, and I am responsible for building customizable and extensible human approval workflows with Azure Durable Functions. I also improved the report generation speed by 90%, increased the code coverage by 60%, and mentored and developed junior developers. I am passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that help our clients streamline their contract processes and achieve their business goals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built from scratch a customizable and extensible human approval workflows base on Azure Durable Functions and utilize Azure Storage and Azure Cosmos DB. This helps us move away from SharePoint Designer Workflows.
- Led unit tests initiative to start including unit tests as part of the development process. Managed to increase the code coverage of the entire code base from 0% to 60%.
- Increased report generation speed by 90% and reduced memory consumption by switching from DOM approach to SAX approach using OpenXmlWriter to write large sheet of data.
- In charged of release process which took place every three weeks.
- Mentored and developed junior developers and engineers to increase productivity.
- Performed estimates of work hours and tracked progress using Agile and Scrum methodology
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Azure Cosmos DB · TypeScript · Distributed Systems · .NET Core · Azure Functions · API Development · Microsoft Azure · Azure Key Vault · .NET Framework · Unit Testing · Azure DevOps
